• Ph.D. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Faculty of Science. Thesis: AI-Driven Molecular Foundation Model for Cancer Pathology and Precision Medicine
  • Developing AI methods to quantify tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) from H&E whole-slide images in triple-negative breast cancer
  • Studying whether the biomarker stays reliable across different patient populations and imaging sources, with a focus on underrepresented African and Moroccan cohorts

• Developing high-accuracy AI models that predict mutations from whole-slide images (94% benchmark accuracy) for applied computational-pathology and precision-oncology research
  • As R&D Intern (Feb - Aug 2025), engineered an end-to-end EGFR mutation prediction pipeline from whole-slide images, outperforming existing solutions by 15% on benchmark datasets
  • Co-organised the 1st Congress of Digital Pathology and represented DataPathology at two further international AI-in-oncology conferences

• Accepted for a fully funded place at the CCAIM Machine Learning for Healthcare Summer School, supported by GSK
  • Presented in the exhibition session: Do immune biomarkers stay true across populations? Trustworthy AI for TILs in triple-negative breast cancer

• M.Eng. in Big Data & Artificial Intelligence with a full (100%) merit scholarship. Coursework: Deep Learning, Medical Image Analysis, Statistical Modelling, Large-Scale Data Systems
  • TIL spatial quantification & tumour subtype classification (2024 - 2025): multi-task foundation model for joint TIL quantification and adenocarcinoma / adenoma classification for precision immunotherapy
  • Breast cancer detection AI (2023 - 2024): computer-vision system, 94% accuracy, 60% faster diagnosis, validated against physician annotations
• Taught English, algorithms and logic to young learners through summer camps and workshops
